text: A muscular male with a lean, tanned build. His long blonde hair is braided down his back. He has a square jaw, light eyes, and a short beard. Bare-chested, wearing fur-trimmed arm bands and a black cord necklace with a circular pendant. He crouches forward slightly, head tilted, gazing intently ahead. Behind him, blurred figures in brown furs stand at attention. The setting appears rugged and outdoor.
